source.book: KET青少版官方真题1（扫描版）

parts.1:
Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment before we start the test. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 1
One. How did Stan and his dad get home from the concert?
Girl: How was the concert, Stan? You look tired!
Boy: I am. It was great, but Dad and I got home really late.
Girl: Isn’t there a train station near the concert hall?
Boy: There is, but there are no trains after 10 o’clock. And the taxis were all busy, so we got a bus. It took so long! Next time I’ll wait for a taxi!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. What’s the girl forgotten?
Man: Why are you back home so soon? You should be on your way to the swimming pool!
Girl: I know, Dad. But I forgot something.
Man: Oh, do you need more money for the bus?
Girl: Thanks, but I’ve got enough. When I got to the pool, I looked for my swimming costume in my bag, but I only had my towel!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. What will the boy do first after he gets home from school?
Boy: We’re going to stay with my cousins tomorrow.
Girl: Are you all ready to go?
Boy: Almost. Dad has to pick up the train tickets, and as soon as I get in after lessons I have to help make sandwiches for the journey.
Girl: Have you packed?
Boy: I’ve almost finished. I won’t need many clothes and I can do it later tonight.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. Where did the girl find her phone?
Girl: I couldn’t find my phone for four days. I looked everywhere. I never take my phone to school, but I even looked in my classroom desk!
Boy: Bad luck!
Girl: It was actually in the back of my dad’s car. I saw it when he gave me a lift to school this morning.
Boy: Maybe it fell out of your bag!
Girl: Yeah, maybe.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. Where are the two friends going to go first today?
Man: So, how about going to the museum before it gets too busy?
Woman: Maybe we could go to the castle before we go there? It’s too sunny to be inside a museum right now.
Man: Alright, but we’ve got to use our theatre tickets by today.
Woman: Let’s do that after we finish visiting the museum.
Man: Sure.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have ten seconds.
You will hear a man talking about a course for teenagers who are interested in working on the radio.
Man: This year’s Radio Camp is going to be at our radio station on 102 Golden Street.
Our popular three-week summer camps are already getting full! We start on June 25th, but if you can’t come then, there’s another camp starting on July 16th, and the last one’s on August 6th.
At camp, we’ll teach you how to use radio equipment and to write a play for young actors. This summer you won’t learn how to write about the news.
You’ll meet the local journalist, Luke Berry, and a very well-known band who’ve just finished a world tour! We’ll tell you who it is when you join.
Everyone gets a T-shirt to wear at camp. All you need to bring are your own snacks and some great ideas. And wear comfortable clothes like sneakers and shorts.
If you book before midnight, you’ll get a discount! $476 is the usual price, but now it’s half-price – $238. To get this special offer, visit our website.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have twenty seconds.
You will hear Edward talking to his friend Michaela about dance classes.
Michaela: Hi, Edward, do you go to the dance school for your dance classes?
Edward: Hi, Michaela. They’re too expensive there. My classes were at the sports centre last year, but they moved to the college.
Michaela: Oh, OK.
Edward: And how often do you have classes?
Michaela: Once a week, and it’s an eight-week course.
Edward: You’ve been to four classes already, haven’t you?
Michaela: That’s right. Is your teacher good?
Edward: She quickly shows us what to do instead of explaining, which is OK most of the time. She laughs when we make mistakes, but in a nice way! And, what’s really nice, if you do something well, you get a little packet of sweets.
Michaela: Oh, nice!
Edward: What do you wear for your classes?
Michaela: When I wore shorts and a T-shirt, they weren’t warm enough, and trainers and a sweater aren’t good for dancing in, so I just wear comfortable trousers and a shirt.
Edward: Me too.
Michaela: Do you enjoy your classes?
Edward: Yes. Remembering the different dances isn’t easy, but I always have fun with my classmates. I wish I could choose the music – it’s not very good!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a brother and sister talking about a present for their cousin, Ben. Why did the girl choose the bag?
Boy: Did you manage to get Ben’s birthday present?
Girl: Yes, I wanted to get a towel he can use after swimming, but they were all very expensive. I thought about a football poster, but the ones in the shop were enormous and his room’s small.
Boy: What did you get?
Girl: A bag! He hasn’t got anything to put his sports kit in.
Boy: Great choice!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a boy talking to a friend about a computer game. Why doesn’t he buy it now?
Girl: How about this computer game? It’s £45.
Boy: I really loved playing it at my friend’s house. But that’s too much.
Girl: But it’s worth it! I borrowed it from my cousin and didn’t want to give it back!
Boy: I’d love to get it, and then we can play it for as long as we like. But I’ll have to save up for it.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking together. Where are they?
Girl: What a fantastic view! You can see all the way down the valley to the lake.
Boy: Look at the sheep we passed when we were near the farm! They look like white flowers from up here.
Girl: You know, I wanted to stop when we came out of the wood, but I’m glad we kept going.
Boy: So am I.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a girl, Kate, talking to her father. What’s Kate’s father going to do?
Girl: Have you seen this advert, Dad?
Man: Which advert? ... No, I haven’t. I hardly ever read magazines.
Girl: It says one lucky reader and their family can win a trip to Canada to see where they film my favourite TV series. You have to be over eighteen to take part.
Man: Then I’ll put my name on the form. I’d love to visit Canada.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about last weekend. What did the boy do?
Girl: How was your weekend? Did you buy that book you need for school?
Boy: I was going to, but Jack came to see me on Saturday. He was absent from school last week, so he needed to borrow my notes. It was too late to go out afterwards.
Girl: Never mind, I’m passing that shop later, so I can get it for you.
Boy: Thanks.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have fifteen seconds.
You will hear Beth talking to Jack about a class trip. What will each person bring on the trip?
Beth: It’s only two days before the class trip, Jack!
Jack: Yes. Everyone’s agreed what they’re going to bring. I’m bringing my good camera, so we can get some group photos.
Beth: Great. And I know Edward’s bringing something to carry all the stuff to eat, which’ll be really helpful.
Jack: Good idea. And what about you, Beth?
Beth: Well, I think it’ll be nice to have some music. I’ve decided to pack a small drum because my guitar’s too heavy.
Jack: Yes, of course. And Dan’s offered to bring some things for playing games, some bats and balls, I think.
Beth: That’ll be great, but not everyone wants to do activities that make you tired.
Jack: Yolanda’s thought of that! She has lots of art equipment, which we can all share.
Beth: Good idea. And I was talking to Gordon about maybe bringing a board game. What do you think?
Jack: Actually, I discussed that with him and we thought we should have something where everyone takes part, answering questions in teams. So he’s going to prepare and bring that.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 男孩说音乐会大厅附近虽有火车站，但 "there are no trains after 10 o’clock"，出租车也 "the taxis were all busy"，最后 "so we got a bus"，可见火车已错过、出租车打不到，两人乘公交车回家，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q2: 女孩说到了泳池翻包找泳衣时，"I looked for my swimming costume in my bag, but I only had my towel!"，包里只有毛巾，忘带的正是游泳衣，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩说 "as soon as I get in after lessons I have to help make sandwiches for the journey"，即一放学回家第一件事就是帮忙做旅途吃的三明治，因此选择 C；收拾行李 "I can do it later tonight"，不是最先做的事。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩说找了一圈后 "It was actually in the back of my dad’s car."，手机其实在爸爸汽车后座，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 男士提议 "how about going to the museum before it gets too busy?"，女士虽想先去城堡，但最后同意先逛博物馆，剧院票 "Let’s do that after we finish visiting the museum."，所以第一站是博物馆，因此选择 C。
explanations.p2q1: 男士说 "We start on June 25th"，第一期营地 6 月 25 日开始，因此填 25 June / June 25(th)；"another camp starting on July 16th" 和 "the last one’s on August 6th" 是后面两期，不要误填。
explanations.p2q2: 男士说营地会教 "to write a play for young actors"，并明确 "This summer you won’t learn how to write about the news"，学写的是戏剧（plays）而不是新闻，因此填 plays。
explanations.p2q3: 男士说 "You’ll meet the local journalist, Luke Berry, and a very well-known band who’ve just finished a world tour!"，能见到世界知名的乐队，因此填 band；记者 Luke Berry 只是 local（当地），不算 world famous。
explanations.p2q4: 男士说 "Everyone gets a T-shirt to wear at camp"，每人发一件 T 恤，因此填 T-shirt；需要自带的是 "your own snacks and some great ideas"，不是收到的物品。
explanations.p2q5: 男士说 "$476 is the usual price, but now it’s half-price – $238"，半价优惠是 238 美元，因此填 238；476 是原价，不要误填。
explanations.p3q1: Edward 说舞蹈学校 "They’re too expensive there"，他的课 "My classes were at the sports centre last year, but they moved to the college"，现在搬到了大学，因此选择 A（a college）。
explanations.p3q2: 课程 "Once a week, and it’s an eight-week course"，每周一次；Edward 说 "You’ve been to four classes already, haven’t you?"，Michaela 确认 "That’s right"，已上四次课即四周前开始，因此选择 B（four weeks ago）。
explanations.p3q3: Edward 说 "if you do something well, you get a little packet of sweets"，表现好老师会给一小包糖果，即送学生小礼物，因此选择 B；不是 A，老师只是 "laughs when we make mistakes, but in a nice way"；也不是 C，老师 "shows us what to do instead of explaining"，并不靠讲解。
explanations.p3q4: Michaela 说穿过 "shorts and a T-shirt" 但 "they weren’t warm enough"，"trainers and a sweater aren’t good for dancing in"，所以 "I just wear comfortable trousers and a shirt"，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q5: Edward 说 "I always have fun with my classmates"，最喜欢和同学们在一起的时光，因此选择 C；学新舞 "Remembering the different dances isn’t easy"，音乐方面 "I wish I could choose the music – it’s not very good!"，故 A、B 不对。
explanations.p4q1: 女孩放弃太贵的毛巾（"they were all very expensive"）和放不下的大海报（"his room’s small"）后买了包，因为 "He hasn’t got anything to put his sports kit in."，表弟正需要装运动装备，包很实用，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩虽然喜欢这个游戏（"I really loved playing it at my friend’s house."），但听到 £45 后说 "But that’s too much."，还说 "I’ll have to save up for it."，嫌太贵要攒钱，因此选择 B；"I borrowed it from my cousin" 说的是女孩自己，不是男孩能借到。
explanations.p4q3: 女孩说 "You can see all the way down the valley to the lake."，男孩说羊群 "look like white flowers from up here"，两人正从高处俯瞰山谷与湖，在山上，因此选择 C；农场（"when we were near the farm"）和树林（"when we came out of the wood"）都只是路过的地方。
explanations.p4q4: Kate 告诉爸爸广告上说 "one lucky reader and their family can win a trip to Canada"，爸爸说 "Then I’ll put my name on the form."，要填表参加抽奖比赛，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩本来要去买书，"but Jack came to see me on Saturday"，帮缺课的 Jack 补笔记后 "It was too late to go out afterwards."，整个周末待在家里，因此选择 B；是 Jack 来找他而不是他去拜访同学，书也没买成。
explanations.p5q1: Beth 说 "I know Edward’s bringing something to carry all the stuff to eat"，Edward 带的是装食物的袋子，对应 picnic bag，因此选 F。
explanations.p5q2: Beth 说 "I’ve decided to pack a small drum because my guitar’s too heavy"，她带的是小鼓而不是吉他，因此选 C（drum）。
explanations.p5q3: Jack 说 "Dan’s offered to bring some things for playing games, some bats and balls, I think."，球拍和球属于运动器材，因此选 H（sports equipment）。
explanations.p5q4: Jack 说 "Yolanda’s thought of that! She has lots of art equipment, which we can all share."，她带的是美术用品，对应 pencils and paints，因此选 E。
explanations.p5q5: Gordon 原本想带棋盘游戏，但 Jack 说两人商量后决定带 "something where everyone takes part, answering questions in teams"，即分组答题的问答比赛，因此选 G（quiz）。
